definitions.full: H1667. Gath -rimmon גַּתרִֿמּוֺן proper name, of a location in Dan Josh 19:45 ; Levitical city 21:24 = 1Chr 6:54 ; site unknown. — רִמּוֺן גַּת in Manasseh Josh 21:25 is scribal error; read יִבְלְעָם , q. v.

occurrences.englishText: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
